title: The Data Center Backlash Should Also Be a Climate Reckoning. It Isn’t Yet
summary: Data centers were a hot topic at Climate Week, but it’s also a self-selecting event where people care about one particular issue. That doesn’t even account for gas power plants being built off the grid to service data centers.
